```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(mocapr)

files2 <- list.files("mocap_02", pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
sess2  <- map(files2, read_one) |> list_rbind()

both_sess <- bind_rows(
  sess_fixed |> mutate(session = "Session 1"),
  sess2      |> mutate(session = "Session 2")
)

as <- both_sess |>
  filter(skeleton %in% c("Alexia", "Simon")) |>
  group_by(session, skeleton) |>
  arrange(frame, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(speed_ms = sqrt((CGX - lag(CGX))^2 + (CGZ - lag(CGZ))^2) / 1000 * 50) |>
  ungroup()

as |>
  group_by(skeleton, session) |>
  summarise(mean_speed_ms = mean(speed_ms, na.rm = TRUE),
            distance_m    = sum(speed_ms, na.rm = TRUE) / 50,
            .groups = "drop")
as |>
  mutate(window = floor(time_seconds / 10) * 10) |>
  group_by(session, skeleton, window) |>
  summarise(mean_speed = mean(speed_ms, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(window, mean_speed, colour = session)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~ skeleton, ncol = 1) +
  labs(x = "Time (s)", y = "Mean speed (m/s)", colour = NULL)

ggplot(as, aes(CGX, CGZ, colour = time_seconds)) +
  geom_path() +
  coord_equal() +
  facet_grid(session ~ skeleton) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c()

follow_windows <- function(data, leader, follower, delays = 0:300) {
  pair <- inner_join(
    data |> filter(skeleton == leader) |>
      select(frame, time_seconds, leader_x = CGX, leader_z = CGZ),
    data |> filter(skeleton == follower) |>
      select(frame, follower_x = CGX, follower_z = CGZ),
    by = "frame"
  )

  map(delays, \(d)
    pair |>
      mutate(lx = lag(leader_x, d), lz = lag(leader_z, d),
             window = floor(time_seconds / 10) * 10) |>
      group_by(window) |>
      summarise(mean_gap_m = mean(sqrt((lx - follower_x)^2 +
                                       (lz - follower_z)^2), na.rm = TRUE) / 1000,
                .groups = "drop") |>
      mutate(delay_s = d / 50)
  ) |>
    list_rbind() |>
    group_by(window) |>
    slice_min(mean_gap_m, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(leader = leader, follower = follower)
}
s2_K <- follow_windows(sess2, "Kevin",  "Bahar") |> mutate(session = "Session 2")
s2_A <- follow_windows(sess2, "Alexia", "Simon") |> mutate(session = "Session 2")

s1_K <- follow_windows(sess_fixed, "Kevin",  "Bahar") |> mutate(session = "Session 1")
s1_A <- follow_windows(sess_fixed, "Alexia", "Simon") |> mutate(session = "Session 1")

leading <- bind_rows(s1_K, s1_A, s2_K, s2_A) |>
  filter(window > 0, window < 120) |>
  mutate(following = mean_gap_m < 0.5 & delay_s > 0 & delay_s < 6)

ggplot(leading, aes(window, delay_s, colour = session)) +
  geom_line(data = filter(leading, following)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = mean_gap_m, shape = following)) +
  facet_wrap(~ leader, ncol = 1) +
  labs(x = "Time (s)", y = "Follower delay (s)", colour = NULL,
       size = "Gap (m)", shape = "Following?")
       
nrow(s1_K)
nrow(s1_A)

unique(sess_fixed$skeleton)

joints<- c("LW", "LE", "LS", "RW", "RE", "RS",
              "LH", "LK", "LA", "LT", "RH", "RK", "RA", "RT")
pos_cols <- paste0(rep(joints, each = 3), c("X", "Y", "Z"))
pos_cols
kin_long <- sess2 |>
  filter(frame %% 5 == 0) |>
  select(skeleton, frame, time_seconds, all_of(pos_cols)) |>
  pivot_longer(all_of(pos_cols),
               names_to = c("joint", "axis"),
               names_pattern = "(.*)([XYZ])$",
               values_to = "pos")
kin <- kin_long |>
  group_by(skeleton, frame, time_seconds, axis) |>
  summarise(range_m = (max(pos) - min(pos)) / 1000, .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = axis, values_from = range_m) |>
  mutate(volume_m3 = X * Y * Z)
ggplot(kin, aes(time_seconds, volume_m3, colour = skeleton)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(x = "Time (s)", y = "Kinesphere (m³)", colour = NULL)  
kin |> group_by(skeleton) |> summarise(median_volume = median(volume_m3)) 
ggplot(kin, aes(time_seconds, volume_m3)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ skeleton, ncol = 1) +
  labs(x = "Time (s)", y = "Kinesphere (m³)")
```
